description: Source code for MMC/SD card management, including mounting, unmounting, logging, and USB mass storage integration in an embedded system.

classes.name: LoggingWithStorage
classes.description: Logging utility associated with storage device.

methods.name: printError
methods.description: Logs FAT filesystem errors, limiting spam after multiple errors.

methods.name: sdStatistics
methods.description: Outputs current SD card status and pin configuration.

methods.name: incLogFileName
methods.description: Increments log file index and updates filename for logging.

methods.name: prepareLogFileName
methods.description: Prepares the filename for a new log file based on date and index.

methods.name: createLogFile
methods.description: Creates and opens a new log file for appending data.

methods.name: listDirectory
methods.description: Lists log files in the directory, filtering by prefix.

methods.name: readLogFileContent
methods.description: Placeholder for reading log file content (not implemented).

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a line of text to the current log file.

methods.name: MMCumount
methods.description: Unmounts SD card, closes files, and disconnects filesystem.

methods.name: MMCmount
methods.description: Mounts SD card, initializes filesystem, and creates log file.

methods.name: MMCmonThread
methods.description: Background thread monitoring SD card insertion/removal and logging.

methods.name: isSdCardAlive
methods.description: Checks if SD card filesystem is active.

methods.name: initMmcCard
methods.description: Initializes MMC card interface, configures SPI, and registers console commands.
